title: PluginJsonManifest
description:
Parsed and validated `plugin.json` manifest.

This is the public plugin contract used by the plugin registry and PDK. Every plugin distributed via the Cascade plugin ecosystem must include a `plugin.json` file at the root of its plugin directory.

capabilities.description:
List of capability tokens this plugin declares (subset of allowed vocabulary).

Allowed tokens: `"fs_read"`, `"fs_write"`, `"net_outbound"`, `"env_read"`.

description.description: One-line description shown in the plugin browser.

entry_wasm.description: Relative path from the plugin directory to the compiled WASM entry-point (e.g. `"plugin.wasm"`). Must not be an absolute path.

exports.description: Exported WASM function names this plugin exposes (e.g. `["run", "describe"]`).

kind.description: Plugin kind — determines the ABI surface and sandbox resource limits.

min_cascade_version.description: Minimum Cascade version required to run this plugin (semver requirement, e.g. `">=0.2.0"`).

permissions.description: Permissions required by this plugin (DENY-by-default; empty = none).

version.description: Plugin version — must be a valid semver string (e.g. `"1.2.3"`).

name.description: Variable name the plugin may read (e.g. `"HOME"`).

FsPermission.description:
Filesystem permission scope.

`path` must be a relative path or an explicit token such as `"$HOME"`. Absolute paths are rejected to prevent manifest authors from escaping the plugin sandbox by declaring `/etc` as a read scope.

JsonPermissions.description:
Aggregated permissions declared in `plugin.json`.

All fields default to empty — DENY-by-default unless explicitly listed.

NetPermission.description:
Network permission scope.

Declare each host the plugin may reach. Wildcards (`"*"`) are rejected.

ports.description: Allowed ports (e.g. `[443, 8080]`). Empty list means all ports.

PluginKind.description:
Plugin kind variants for `plugin.json`.

Defines the contract surface and sandbox resource profile.
